sources.snippet: ONNX_GENAI_TRACE=<path> turns on timeline capture in the profiler; it is zero-cost when the variable is unset. ONNX_GENAI_PROFILE=1 additionally prints the aggregate per-stage table.

sources.title: C++ Examples | microsoft/onnxruntime-genai | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the C++ examples provided with the ONNX Runtime GenAI library, demonstrating how to use the C++ API for low-level integration. These examples showcase practical implementations for text generation, multimodal processing with vision, and speech recognition capabilities.
